observations.behavior: Adds a new unit test checking that account matching works when account identity is derived from person group membership rather than direct email association.
observations.posthog_connection: Demonstrates support for account-group-based identity resolution, allowing customers to be identified via their assigned groups instead of just personal emails. This supports broader account management and potentially more accurate attribution.

observations.behavior: Uses configuration setting to enable account-group type index, indicating opt-in behavior and configurability.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows teams to configure account identification strategy without changing code, supporting enterprise use cases where account relationships are managed externally.

review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's warehouse and account-management workflows, particularly for teams using account-based identity resolution rather than email-only matching. Could help reduce false negatives when syncing meetings with accounts that have group identities but no direct personal records.
